verdict.rationale: The axis applies because RingCentral runs a public developer portal that could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The direct probe found no llms.txt at developers.ringcentral.com (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack documents agent-oriented documentation. The MCP servers and the 'connect to ChatGPT & Claude' integrations are adjacent capabilities belonging to other stories, so they earn no credit here.
